note: Disc golf (D-069). Flight (DiscFlightRules): lift = g x (lift_base + lift_glide x glide) x (1 - lift_power + lift_power x power) x (speed / launch speed)^2, quadratic drag drag / (1 + drag_speed x disc speed); above turn_start of full speed the disc rolls right by turn x turn_rate_deg/s, below fade_start (once slowed to fade_after_slow of its launch speed, so putts fly straight) it rolls left by fade x fade_rate_deg/s (mirrored for forehand); the roll tilts lift sideways. The HUD power mark (reach) is where the disc comes down to aim_height_m (the chains) on flat ground. Launch pitch = camera pitch + launch_pitch_add_deg, clamped. Canopy: tree crowns (from the planted trees) knock the disc down at canopy_hits_per_m. Basket (Mach II-ish, metres above its base): caught inside catch_radius_m between tray_low_m and chains_high_m when slower than catch_max_mps, else it spits out. Rounds: start within start_radius_m of the box, throw within lie_radius_m of your disc (tee_radius_m of the tee), max_strokes per hole then pick up, abandon leave_m outside the course bounds. Rewards: loot tables by result. Wind (D-076): 0..wind_max_mph, shifts every wind_shift_s seconds during a round (speed by up to 40% of the max, direction by up to wind_turn_max_deg); drag works on the disc's speed through the air, so the disc drifts with the wind (wind_effect scales it). Ace replay: the last ace_slowmo_s of the flight plays at ace_slowmo speed.
